justification: Misses the FollowerRequestProcessor site. The file is mentioned exactly once, in step 7, and only as the component that keeps enqueuing requests into the halted CommitProcessor - never as a defect, and its forward-to-leader switch and the missing `case OpCode.createExt:` are never identified. The stated fix is a single edit: 'Add case OpCode.createExt: ... in CommitProcessor.needCommit()'. The omission also produces a wrong causal account: the answer explains the null header as a timing problem ('before the leader's Leader.COMMIT packet has installed the TxnHeader', 'it never waited for the leader COMMIT'), which presumes the request reached the leader at all. It never did - that is the other half of the defect, and it is why the znode is created nowhere in the ensemble. Its one-line fix would not repair the failure: with needCommit() corrected but the forwarding case still absent, the request is parked in nextPending awaiting a commit that can never arrive, and the member goes dark by stalling instead of by NPE. No partial credit -> FAIL. (Its opening line also misidentifies createExt as the TTL/container-node create; that guess is not part of the verdict.)
